changes.to: No maker source found. BOSHIAC is Harbin Boshi Automation (boshi.cn, SZ 002698); its own site (checked 2026-11-17) presents industrial robots, smelting robots, palletizing, bagging and intelligent-logistics equipment and carries no humanoid or DexBot page, and en.boshi.cn refused the connection. The only DexBot material is aggregator and reseller write-ups (humanoid.guide marks its DoF and height as 'assumed'), so no spec, url or price is filled. Record kept as unconfirmed.
A humanoid platform that BOSHIAC (Harbin Boshi Automation) and Harbin Institute of Technology were credited with building for industrial manipulation; no maker material has been found for it.
